exposure: Elexacaftor-tezacaftor-ivacaftor (ETI) use during pregnancy and/or lactation
cohort: The study included 45 pregnancies from women with cystic fibrosis who used elexacaftor-tezacaftor-ivacaftor (ETI) during pregnancy and/or lactation.
finding: Data from this retrospective survey is reassuring regarding maternal and infant outcomes for women with cystic fibrosis who choose to continue elexacaftor-tezacaftor-ivacaftor (ETI) during pregnancy.
